judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The ellipsis threat in the last line and the 'stranger' address fit a Nox guard. But 'her floor testifies to it' is a joke worked too hard, and 'Come on... Will you come quietly?' repeats itself. The three barks also don't follow on from each other: first the player is arrested, then the guard talks to someone who is already back in a cell.
